# PlayTools

> Independent guide to digital creative tools. Not affiliated with Art Blocks. This site is noindex. Do not submit this file anywhere.

The machine-readable catalog is /tools.json.

## Seed

A piece is a seed kept in the page URL and in localStorage under the key playtools-seed. It is never sent to a server.

Composed page:

/lab/composed/?seed=c19a4e&start=message&tool=1&make=a%20lullaby%20I%20hum%20to%20my%20kids

- seed: 6 lowercase hex digits. Sketch parameters.
- start: message, medium, or maker. The three starting points. Optional. `door` is accepted as the same value.
- pick: the option inside that starting point. Medium: print, plotter, animation, sound, or 3d. Maker: new, designer, musician, or artist. Optional.
- mix: two effect ids joined by +, for example flowfield+dither. Optional. Pairings are labeled "try this pairing" because this pull does not count how often those effects are combined. Library counts that are real: p5.js 842, shaders 394, three.js 84, Tone.js 17, pulled 2026-10-25 19:40 ET.
- tool: 1 through 6. The featured tool on the hero. 1 p5.js, 2 GLSL, 3 Tone.js, 4 pen plotter, 5 SVG, 6 time.
- make: the visitor's phrase. Optional. It prefills the Message finder.
- walk, noise, grid, count, rd, tile: lineage knobs. Optional.

Read the URL first. If seed is absent, read localStorage key playtools-seed. Do not invent a seed if both are missing. Use c19a4e only as the page's own starting seed.

## Starting points

The hero offers three ways in. Each one changes the sketch and the `start` parameter.

- Message: what the visitor wants to say. A feeling or an idea. Tools that can express it.
- Medium: what they want to make. A print, a plotter drawing, animation, sound, or 3D.
- Maker: who they are. New to code, designer, musician, or artist. Tools matched to how they work.

Example: /lab/composed/?start=maker&pick=musician

## Find a tool and make a first sketch

Use only this file and /tools.json.

1. Read howToChoose in /tools.json.
2. Pick one tool object.
3. Fill howToFirstSketch with that tool's name, plain, category, firstProject, starter, and licenseNotes.
4. Put the visitor seed, phrase, and seed URL into the same prompt.
5. The starter field is the tool page, for example /tools/p5/.
6. heroExample is credit for a real work. Do not copy or redraw it. If heroExample is null, there is no verified image.
7. Write an original sketch that uses the seed as its random seed.

## Creative index

/lab/tools/ sizes tools by projectCount from /tools.json.

- projectCount: projects in the Art Blocks pull of 2026-10-25 19:40 ET matched to that tool. Source: https://data.artblocks.io/v1/graphql. 0 is a real zero.
- underused: true when projectCount is under 10. The cutoff is this guide's. The count is not an estimate.
- projectCount null: no data yet. Do not invent a number.
- beginnerFriendly: true only when the tool text says beginner.
- hasStarter: this guide has a starter sketch.
- Category sums are not listed. A project can match more than one tool.
- Named effects in mixes (flow field, boids, and the rest) have no project counts. Say no data yet.

## Generate

/lab/generate/ turns a seed into an edition. Params:

- seed: 6 hex digits. Carried from /lab/composed/.
- mix: two effect ids, for example flowfield+dither. Optional.
- mode: long-form or curated.
- edition: integer from 1 to 10000.
- balance: 0 to 100. 0 is rules, 100 is variance.
- output: one or sheet.
- strikes: comma-separated frame indexes. Optional.

A 1 of 1 is edition=1 and output=one.
A 16-piece curated set is edition=16, mode=curated, and output=sheet.

Manifest JSON downloaded from the output step:

seed, mix, mode, output, edition, balance, band.lo, band.hi, sources (each with on, weight, value), rules (text, fromCuration, maxDensity), strikes, showing, sample.offset, sample.indexes.

edition is the full edition. showing is the live page (at most 64 tiles). sample.indexes are that page. strikes lists every struck index in the edition, including frames that are not on the current page.

Sources may be rng, time, color, movement, sound, data, sensor. Values stay on the device. Nothing is uploaded.

## Keep it forever

The home page and /generate/ can download one file named playtools-<seed>.html. The file holds the seed and inline JavaScript. The home file also includes the pen-plotter SVG. The Generate file also includes a PNG. Opening either file makes no network calls.

ABX FS handoff, link only. This site does not connect a wallet, upload a file, or send a transaction.

1. Download your file.
2. Open https://fs.abx.io
3. Drop the file in.

ABX FS says it is early, unaudited software and may have bugs. What you publish is public and permanent. On production chains, real funds are at risk. Try a testnet first.

Docs: https://docs.fs.abx.io and https://docs.abx.io/docs/using-abx/guides/utilities

## Pages

The short index is /sitemap/. Artist URLs are /sitemap/artists/ and /sitemap/artists/{letter}/ (a–z or other). Project URLs are /sitemap/projects/ and /sitemap/projects/{letter}/. A letter with more than 40 names continues at {letter}-2. Tools are /sitemap/tools/ and continue at /sitemap/tools/2/. Machine-readable copies: /sitemap.json (routes, parameters, and links to letter files) and /sitemap.xml (an index of /sitemap/routes.xml, /sitemap/artists.xml, and /sitemap/projects.xml). Letter files such as /sitemap/artists/a.json list the concrete URLs. Do not parse the HTML for the long lists.

Parameters:

- / : no params.
- /start/ /about/ /abx/ /artists/ /recipes/ /lab/ /lab/tools/ /sitemap/ : no params.
- /explore/?tool= all, or a tool id from /tools.json.
- /artists/{slug}/ one artist. /projects/{slug}/ one project.
- /tools/?group= sound | image | plot | 3d | textile | hardware | agents. /tools/{id}/ one tool.
- /recipes/{slug}/ one recipe. /make/{slug}/ one way of making.
- /lab/composed/ and /lab/hero-1/ through /lab/hero-5/ read seed, start (door is the same), pick, mix, tool (1-6), make, walk, noise, grid, count, rd, tile.
- /lab/generate/ reads seed, mix, mode (long-form | curated), edition (1-10000), balance (0-100), output (one | sheet), strikes (comma-separated frame indexes).
- /lab/tools/{id}/ one tool in the creative index.
- /lab/suggest/?suggest= tool | example | fix | claim | removal. about= the artist, tool, or page.

- /lab/composed/ is the whole piece.
- /lab/suggest/ is the suggestion form. Same fields and the same email draft as before.
- /lab/hero-1/ through /lab/hero-5/ are the ingredients.
- /tools/ is the tool index. /tools/{id}/ is one tool.
- /sitemap/ is the short index. /sitemap/artists/ and /sitemap/projects/ are the long lists, one letter per page.
- /abx/ is the publish path.
